building.Zoo.name: Zoo
building.Zoo.description: A walk-in zoo with six biome habitats. Visitors buy tickets every day. Holds 8 animals.
building.BigZoo.name: Big Zoo
building.BigZoo.description: A grander zoo. Holds 16 animals and draws more visitors.
building.DeluxeZoo.name: Deluxe Zoo
building.DeluxeZoo.description: The best zoo in the valley. Holds 24 animals and is the talk of Pelican Town.
animal.Penguin.name: Penguin
animal.Penguin.description: A waddling crowd-pleaser for the ice habitat.
animal.Panda.name: Panda
animal.Panda.description: Visitors travel from far away to see it in the jungle.
animal.Lion.name: Lion
animal.Lion.description: The king of the savanna enclosure.
animal.Giraffe.name: Giraffe
animal.Giraffe.description: Tall enough to watch the whole savanna.
animal.Monkey.name: Monkey
animal.Monkey.description: A chattering acrobat for the jungle habitat.

animal.Capybara.description: The world's chillest rodent. Loves the water habitat.
animal.Elephant.name: Elephant
animal.Elephant.description: A giant of the savanna. Needs plenty of space.
animal.Dinosaur.name: Dinosaur
animal.Dinosaur.description: A prehistoric star for the fossil habitat.
animal.Gorilla.name: Gorilla
animal.Gorilla.description: A powerful ape that shares the jungle with pandas.
animal.Raccoon.name: Raccoon
animal.Raccoon.description: A masked forest bandit with clever little hands.
animal.Alpaca.name: Alpaca
animal.Alpaca.description: A fluffy savanna grazer with excellent bangs.
animal.SeaLion.name: Sea Lion
animal.SeaLion.description: A barking show-off for the water habitat.

animal.Bear.description: A lumbering forest resident with a sweet tooth.

animal.Owl.description: A tufted night hunter that perches in the forest.
animal.Deer.name: Deer
animal.Deer.description: A slender forest grazer with branching antlers.
animal.NightHeron.name: Night Heron
animal.NightHeron.description: A stocky water bird with a dark cap and a long bill.
